Collection.definition: The adversary is trying to gather data of interest to their goal.

Command and Control.definition: The adversary is trying to communicate with compromised systems to control them.

Credential Access.definition: The adversary is trying to steal account names and passwords.

Defense Evasion.definition: The adversary is trying to avoid being detected.

Discovery.definition: The adversary is trying to figure out your environment.

Execution.definition: The adversary is trying to run malicious code.

Exfiltration.definition: The adversary is trying to steal data.

Impact.definition: The adversary is trying to manipulate, interrupt, or destroy your systems and data.

Initial Access.definition: The adversary is trying to get into your network.

Lateral Movement.definition: The adversary is trying to move through your environment.

Persistence.definition: The adversary is trying to maintain their foothold.

Privilege Escalation.definition: The adversary is trying to gain higher-level permissions.

Reconnaissance.definition: The adversary is trying to gather information they can use to plan future operations.

Resource Development.definition: The adversary is trying to establish resources they can use to support operations.
